name: pp-max
effect: Used on a party Pokémon : Increases a selected move’s max PP to 1.6× its original max PP. Increases happiness by 5/3/2.
shortEffect: Raises a move’s max PP by 60%.

flavorTextEntries.text: Raises the PP of a move to its maximum points.
Raises the PP of a selected move to its maximum level for one POKéMON.
It maximally raises the top PP of a selected move that has been learned by the target Pokémon.
A medicine that can optimally raise the maximum PP of a single move that has been learned by the target Pokémon.
A medicine that optimally raises the maximum PP of a single selected move that has been learned by a Pokémon.
